raw_site_text: 75 villages in Karnataka, India ... spread across five districts of the state of Karnataka; 104 neighbourhoods in Hyderabad
justification: The study covers '75 villages in Karnataka' and an RCT in '104 neighbourhoods in Hyderabad', which is now in Telangana.
note: Hyderabad was the capital of undivided Andhra Pradesh at the time; mapped to Telangana per current boundaries. Karnataka districts unnamed.
